title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-harper-wu
content:
2026-03-12 - morning triage
Owner: Harper Wu (notes + runbook edits)
Context:
- CS reported intermittent dashboard blanks for some Hosted API customers (Acme Corp, Zendesk 12345). Customers see empty panels on 'Per-route token cost' and 'P50 latency by model' in the last 24h.
- Spike in backend latency correlates with a backlog on ingestion pipeline (metrics-collector). Suspect recent rollout of metrics agent (agent v2.4.1) caused partial metric tagging loss.

Symptoms observed:
- Grafana panel 'Per-route token cost' shows 0 values from ~2026-03-11 22:30 to 2026-03-12 02:15 UTC for ~15% of routes.
- P50 latency panel shows sudden drop to 0 for gptx-8b then returns to normal (likely missing points, not actual zero latency).
- No increase in error logs from serving runtime; alerts only from dashboard-derived SLO check (SLO-queries failing due to missing series).

Immediate repro steps to run (for me / SRE):
1) Query raw metrics in BigQuery for sample route:
   SELECT timestamp, route, metric_name, value
   FROM metric_ingest.raw_metrics
   WHERE route = 'customer/acme/route/chat'
     AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-11 21:00:00' AND '2026-03-12 03:00:00'
   ORDER BY timestamp DESC
- Look for missing metric_name = 'token_cost' rows or null tags.

2) Check metrics-collector logs for agent rollout windows:
   kubectl -n observability logs deploy/metrics-collector --since=6h | grep v2.4.1
   Look for warnings about tag parsing or 400 responses from tagging service.

3) Reproduce locally by forcing partial ingestion (dev cluster): run agent v2.4.1 against a subset of routes and observe tag emission.

Quick findings so far:
- Jordan ran initial BigQuery query and found null values in tag column 'route_id' ~22:45-23:10 UTC (attached query link in OBS-4123).
- Maya confirmed metrics-collector had a transient OOM on one pod during rollout window; pod restarted and was rescheduled. Logs show the restart at 22:47 UTC.
- Owen pulled agent config diff and found memory limit was lowered in recent k8s manifest (accidental).

Impact assessment:
- Affects dashboard panels that aggregate by route and model tags => results in missing series and apparent zeros.
- Customers reporting are seeing empty panels; not affecting serving correctness but visibility and SLO reporting (false negatives).
- Priority: P2 customer impact (several mid-size customers), escalate to P1 if more customers surface or SLO alert fires for business-critical routes.

Next actions (TODOs):
- [ ] Roll back metrics agent to v2.3.7 on prod for observability namespace (Harper + Owen) - targeted window 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC.
- [ ] Re-run BigQuery reconciliations for missing intervals and backfill missing series where possible (Jordan).
- [ ] Increase memory limit in k8s manifest and add resource guardrail to prevent accidental lowering (Maya).
- [ ] Add quick check in rollout pipeline to verify tag emission (create a smoke test that emits a small set of tagged metrics and validates ingestion). (Harper)
- [ ] Notify CS and send templated status update to Acme + other reported customers (templates in OBS-4123). (Owen)

Notes to self / runbook edits:
- Add a section on 'dashboard blanks' under observability runbook: heuristic checks (missing tags, series count, ingestion lag).
- Add a Grafana panel-level fallback that shows a clear 'data missing' banner when series count < threshold (UX ask to product if feasible).

Follow-ups / meetings:
- 2026-03-12 16:00 UTC quick sync with SRE + metrics team to approve rollback and backfill plan (calendar invite sent).
- Postmortem owner TBD after immediate mitigation. Draft a short incident timeline in OBS-4123.

Scratch commands / queries to paste quickly:
- BigQuery sample: bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '\n  SELECT timestamp, route, metric_name, value, route_id FROM metric_ingest.raw_metrics WHERE metric_name IN (\'token_cost\', \'latency_ms\') AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP("2026-03-11 21:00:00") AND TIMESTAMP("2026-03-12 03:00:00") ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000'
- kubectl: kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide | grep metrics-collector
- grafana panel link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/observability/summary

Quick comms draft to CS (send after rollback confirmed):
- Subject: Observability dashboard issue - temporary metrics ingestion disruption
- Body: Hi, team. We identified a metrics ingestion issue caused by a recent agent rollout that temporarily removed route tags for a subset of metrics. We are rolling back the agent and backfilling the missing data. Expect dashboards to show corrected data within 2-4 hours after rollback. We will follow up once the backfill completes and share the incident summary.

Misc notes:
- Double-check retention / backfill cost estimate before running wide backfill (billing cc: finance).
- Consider adding automated alert when series count for a critical dashboard drops >50% vs baseline for 30m.

End of scratchpad (save to Drive and link from OBS-4123).
